changelog: Notify me on a shop list's cards carries a filter over only when it chooses one of the product's sizes. Before, every filter_* in the list's address became an attribute_pa_* on the product's: on a list filtered by stock status, each card's Notify me led to …?attribute_pa_stock_status=outofstock#crestock. Now a filter is carried only for an attribute the product's variations use, with a single one of their values (Decks filtered by width still open with 8.25″ chosen), and a simple product's Notify me is its own address plus #crestock, whatever the filters.
